title: DALL·E 2: Extending creativity
summary: As part of our DALL·E 2 research preview, more than 3,000 artists from more than 118 countries have incorporated DALL·E into their creative workflows. The artists in our early access group have helped us discover new uses for DALL·E and have served as key voices as we’ve made decisions about DALL·E’s features.
body: As part of our DALL·E 2 research preview, more than 3,000 artists from more than 118 countries have incorporated DALL·E into their creative workflows. The artists in our early access group have helped us discover new uses for DALL·E and have served as key voices as we’ve made decisions about DALL·E’s features.
summaryZh: DALL·E 2：扩展创造力。作为我们 DALL·E 2 研究预览的一部分，来自超过 118 个国家的 3,000 多名艺术家已将 DALL·E 纳入他们的创意工作流程。我们抢先体验小组的艺术家帮助我们发现了 DALL·E 的新用途，并在我们就 DALL·E 的功能做出决定时发挥了关键作用。
